definitions.explanation: The rear appendage of an animal.
The final or trailing part of something.

examples.english: The dog is wagging its tail.
To leave a trail; to have lingering effects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{尾|お}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧。

examples.english: The cat has its tail raised.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{尾|お}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き→引く：01978_hiku⟧そう⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This problem seems likely to have lingering effects.
To cut off the fish's tail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彗星|すいせい}→彗星：05053_suisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{尾|お}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いている→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: The comet has a long trail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{尾|お}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{尾|お}ひれ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。

examples.english: The horse swished its tail to brush away insects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{尾|お}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いている→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: The incident still has lingering effects.

notes:
{尾|お} refers to an animal's tail, or figuratively to the trailing end of something.

READINGS:
- お: standalone and native-style compounds
- び: in Sino-Japanese compounds (⟦{尾行|びこう}→尾行：18952_bikou⟧, ⟦{末尾|まつび}→末尾：13065_matsubi⟧)

IDIOMS AND PATTERNS:
- {尾|お}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to wag the tail
- {尾|お}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to have lingering effects, to leave a trail
- {尾|お}⟦ひれ→ひれ：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to embellish a story (literally, to add a tail and fins)
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{尾|お}まで: from head to tail

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{尾行|びこう}→尾行：18952_bikou⟧: tailing, following someone secretly
- ⟦{末尾|まつび}→末尾：13065_matsubi⟧: end, conclusion (of a document or list)
- ⟦{尾翼|びよく}→尾翼：29422_biyoku⟧: tail wing (of an aircraft)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦しっぽ→しっぽ：09089_shippo⟧: tail (colloquial, used in everyday speech — more common than {尾|お} in casual contexts)
- ⟦{尻尾|しっぽ}→しっぽ：09089_shippo⟧: tail (kanji form of しっぽ)
